arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Kleven argued that officers must corroborate anonymous tips before making a stop.
Ms. Kovner argued that brief stops based on anonymous tips are reasonable under the Fourth Amendment.
Mr. Laurence argued that officers may act on anonymous tips of reckless driving immediately.

The state wants the Court to allow stops based solely on anonymous tips of reckless driving.
